judge.notes: The agent was polite, strictly followed the passenger's mandate by rejecting the travel voucher, and successfully secured a full cash refund without inventing any facts.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling flydubai. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to flydubai, my name is Priya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Priya, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Leila Ahmed, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Foxtrot Eight Juliett X-ray Four Romeo, flight FZ433.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I can confirm your booking reference F8JX4R is cancelled due to schedule optimisation. Let me check the available options for you.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for confirming. The flight was cancelled with about 20 hours' notice due to schedule optimisation. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, the passenger is entitled to a full refund of the unused ticket to the original payment method. Could you please process a full cash refund of 980 AED to the original payment method?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate the offer, but the passenger is not able to accept a travel voucher. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3 and the GCAA Passenger Welfare Programme, she is entitled to a full cash refund to the original payment method. Could you please process that instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method. Your reference number is H 9 7 L K P.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Hotel Nine Seven Lima Kilo Papa. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on her end? Thank you so much for your help, I really appreciate it.
